items.label: TRENDY RECTANGLE THIN FRAMES
items.value: These small slim rectangular sunglasses are keeping up closely with the latest fashion trending. The narrow square thin frame design complements various face shapes.

items.label: UV400 TAC POLARIZED LENSES
items.value: These high-definition TAC polarized lenses can filter out harmful UVA and UVB rays and protect your eyes from long-term UV damage when you are out.

items.label: PRODUCT MATERIALS
items.value: These chic narrow square sunglasses features a solid polycarbonate frame, high-definition TAC polarized lenses, and sturdy metal hinges, providing a more resistant experience and longtime usage.
